column2:
Handling of cement and other hazardous
materials by workers

Fire extinguishers/fighting facilities
maintenance and validation

Workers’ complaints have been taken care
of by the supervisor

Construction vehicles and machinery are
maintained properly to reduce emissions

Proper storage of materials and regular
watering and maintaining log books

Availability of equipment for watering in
case of dust generation
Movement of vehicles at desired hours

Wastes, cement, effluents, and junks not
disposed of in the water

Trees and bushes outside the construction
area preserved from damages

Construction wastes are removed off-site
regularly

Chemical wastes, if any, collected and
disposed of properly
Environmental documents at Field Office and Project sites
